title: Investigating the correlations and moderating factors of eating disorder symptoms in autistic individuals
summary: This study investigates the underlying mechanisms, correlations and moderating factors between symptoms of eating disorders and autism in more detail. The aim is to gain a deeper understanding of these links and identify further risk factors and moderating variables. This is based on the observation that eating disorder patients often exhibit characteristics typical of autism. By researching these correlations, it is hoped that a deeper understanding will be developed on which to base more targeted approaches to diagnostics and intervention.

interventions.name: This single-arm, cross-sectional survey involves interviewing participants once using several standardised questionnaires to investigate the relationships between eating characteristics, autism traits, and moderating factors. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
People of all genders, aged 18 and over, who have an autism spectrum diagnosis are eligible to take part. A sufficient understanding of the German language is also required. Participants are recruited via social networks, autism competence centres, parents' associations, and email distribution lists. Fulfillment of the inclusion criteria is checked at the beginning of the online survey.
Exclusion criteria:
No knowledge of German is possessed.
